sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Supplements is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Alright, tourist, you're here at the right time. Got a sixth sense or something? Never mind, listen up. Word on the street is there's some new merchandise making the rounds. Some weird stuff in these fancy-looking chemical containers. Looks a bit like your gun suppressor, just bigger. No clue what's inside: some new narcotic, or bloody Omega-3 or something. That's what we need to find out. The containers showed up at Customs, in the med lab. Get them for me. I've already got a couple of eggheads lined up to examine them. Oh, and one more thing: they asked me to throw in a few respirators and some blood transfusion kits."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the chemical vial on Customs
- Hand over the container
- Find 4 Respirators in raid
- Hand over 4 Respirators to Skier
- Find 3 Medical bloodsets in raid
- Hand over 3 Medical bloodsets to Skier

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.25
- 1,000 Euros
  - 1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Oh, you actually brought them? Nice one! Hands still attached after all that chemical nonsense? Good. I'll get the eggheads on it and see what they can dig up."
